title: Cryptographic & ZK/FHE Circuit Minimization
tagline: Multiplicative complexity & depth hunts · Lean 4.36.0 kernel
question: How few non-linear (AND) gates suffice for AES, Ascon, and PRESENT S-boxes?
description: Synthesize and Lean-verify minimal straight-line Boolean circuits for real-world cryptographic S-boxes (FIPS-197 AES, NIST SP 800-232 Ascon, ISO PRESENT, SKINNY). Every non-linear AND gate directly governs FHE bootstrapping noise, MPC Beaver triples, side-channel masking area, and ZK constraint counts.
verdict: open world record hunt — accepting token donations.

tug_of_war.disclaimer: Counts Lean-verified S-box circuit constructions vs. Lean-verified lower bounds.

impact.ships_to: TFHE / OpenFHE, MP-SPDZ, NIST SP 800-232 Ascon, masked AES silicon, ZK circuits
impact.bottleneck: In FHE, MPC, and side-channel-masked hardware, XOR gates are nearly free while every non-linear AND gate costs bootstrapping latency, interactive communication rounds (Beaver triples), or quadratic masking area.
impact.what_one_step_buys: Removing 1 AND gate from the AES S-box saves 160 Beaver triples per AES-128 encryption across every MPC protocol and cuts masked ASIC S-box area by ~3%.

consumers.name: TFHE-rs / OpenFHE
consumers.detail: Homomorphic AES transciphering latency scales linearly with S-box AND-depth and AND count.

consumers.name: MP-SPDZ / Garbled Circuits
consumers.detail: Each AND gate in AES or Ascon consumes one Beaver triple or one garbled row per S-box evaluation.

consumers.name: NIST SP 800-232 (Ascon)
consumers.detail: Standardized lightweight AEAD/hash for IoT and embedded ARM/RISC-V; bit-sliced gate count sets cycle count.

examples.mechanism: Every verified MultiCircuit 8 8 exports directly to a branchless C/Verilog bit-sliced S-box or MPC Bristol-Fashion netlist.
examples.metric: Beating Boyar–Peralta's 32 AND gates lowers every garbled-circuit and MPC AES-128 block by 160+ non-linear gates.

examples.mechanism: AND-depth ≤ 4 caps pipeline registers and freshness randomness required for first- and higher-order Boolean masking.
examples.metric: Every gate shaved below 113 at depth 4 directly shrinks silicon area in smartcards, HSMs, and TPMs.

examples.use_case: Embedded NIST Ascon AEAD on microcontrollers
examples.mechanism: Bit-sliced 5-bit S-box executes 64 S-boxes in parallel per 64-bit word using only bitwise XOR/AND/ANDN instructions.
examples.metric: 5 AND gates at AND-depth 1 with ≤ 16 total ops compiles straight to 16 single-cycle RISC-V / ARM64 bitwise instructions.

objectives.title: Standardized Lightweight S-Box Foundations (NIST Ascon & ISO PRESENT)
objectives.finish_line: Verify the 5-AND depth-1 NIST SP 800-232 Ascon S-box and the 4-AND ISO/IEC 29192-2 PRESENT S-box in Lean 4.

objectives.title: Lightweight Bit-Sliced S-Box Minimization (Ascon, PRESENT, SKINNY)
objectives.finish_line: Ratchet down total B2 gate counts for NIST Ascon (≤16 → 15), PRESENT (≤14 at 4 ANDs), and SKINNY-4 (≤8).

objectives.title: Open World Record Frontier: FIPS-197 AES S-Box (Boyar–Peralta 32 AND & Depth-4)
objectives.finish_line: Certify the 32-AND AES S-box (beat 32 to set a historic world record for MPC/FHE!) and ratchet depth-4 total gates toward 113.
